_metadata.scope: All significant signed association rows for both source atlases; all tested rows for panel/curated/legacy HPOs. Gene expression covers the explicit gene panel.
_metadata.precision: Numbers parsed and exported without additional rounding. Source zero q values may reflect underflow or upstream rounding; they are not infinite evidence.
_metadata.topDefinition: Within each atlas, the smallest source q among positive estimates meeting q threshold; cell name breaks ties. This is a display ordering, not causal validation.
limitations: Generation commit, HPO/expression release and model configuration are absent from these import files.
Negative signed associations are not positive enrichment; all significant directions remain available.
Estimate/fold-change meanings require the generating model; restored precision does not validate the statistical model.
No phenotype-to-gene or variant causal assertion follows from expression specificity or enrichment alone.
